description: Three turns of narrowing a search. Each turn runs the search and the site's own filter suggestions in parallel, then shows the most popular cars and the suggestions as options. The second turn is the user tapping a suggestion.
notes: A tapped suggestion is sent as a turn whose message is the suggestion's label ("2023 or newer"). That works when labels are unique; Carvana repeats some ("Long Range" for both Model Y and Model 3), so the options shown here skip the repeated ones.
The turns follow the recorded session (searches 01, 02 and 05); the user's third message combines three filters the recording added one at a time.

output.nextStep: To check delivery dates, call get_delivery_dates once with all the vehicle IDs.
